GlobalOptions_description: Settings every task uses. In MXU all instances share these values; in MFAAvalonia each instance has its own.
MirrorTargetFloor_description:
Past floor 5 needs the whole run HARD. From floor 6, the game requires every floor of the run to be HARD. So every enabled team must play HARD from floor 1, and its usage cannot be Normal only. The Difficulty cannot be Normal either. If not, the Mirror Dungeon task stops at its start and says why.

For now, each run still stops at floor 5. The bot cannot yet switch on Parallel Superposition at the entrance, so it uses no weekly bonus either.
MirrorRunsLimit_description: On: the Mirror Dungeon task stops when this many runs have claimed their rewards. A run that gives up its rewards does not count. Off: there is no limit, and the task runs until another stop condition holds.
MirrorThemePackRefresh_description: The bot uses the floor's free refreshes only while the best pack on the page is below the plan's threshold. Then it takes the pack with the highest weight, the leftmost among equals.
MirrorWeeklyBonusUse_description: Weekly bonus rewards on Normal runs are tiny. Use them on Hard runs instead.
MirrorStopWhenBonusOut: Stop when weekly bonuses run out
MirrorAfterRetries_description: What the bot does when the retries after a wipe are used up, or when fewer of a team's deployment order are alive than its threshold. Forfeit the run: no rewards, and the same team plays the next run.
LuxTeam_description:
A team of the settings GUI: the bot uses its in-game team slot (TEAMS #N), deployment order and guard turns. The team need not be enabled.
An empty list: create the team in the settings GUI first, save, then reopen the client. After adding, renaming or deleting a team in the settings GUI and saving, reopen the client too, so the list shows it.
With no team picked, or one that was deleted, the task stops at its start.
ExpMode_description:
The bot plays the rightmost open stage of the EXP tab as it first shows: the hardest stage.
Daily mode: the bot first reads the row "Clear EXP Luxcavation" on the pass's Daily tab. If the row is not done, it fights 1 battle. If the row is done or does not read, it fights none.
Count mode: the bot skips the pass and wins the number of battles set.
ThreadMode_description:
The bot plays today's one open abnormality on the Thread tab. It takes the bottom (hardest) level of the Level Select list.
Daily mode: the bot reads the Daily Bonuses at the top of the tab. At n/3 left, it fights n battles. At 0/3, or when they do not read, it fights none.
Count mode: the bot skips the Daily Bonuses and wins the number of battles set.
LuxRetries_description: A lost battle does not count. Each battle has this many retries, and a win resets them. When a battle is lost with no retry left, the task ends and the task list goes on.
LuxConsecutive_description:
On: each time the bot enters, it sets Consecutive Battle to the battles still to fight, at most 10. It then fights them as one battle. A ×N battle counts as N battles and costs N times the Enkephalin Modules. When more than 10 are left, it fights ×10 first and then the rest.
Off: one battle at a time.
ChargeCount_description:
Caution: above 0, this task spends Lunacy (free Lunacy first, then paid). At 0 it does nothing and never opens the Use Lunacy tab.
The bot charges until today's Daily Count reaches this number, charges made by hand included. When the Daily Count has reached it, or does not read, the bot charges nothing.
The price rises with today's charges: 26, 52, 78... up to 260. Before each Confirm, the bot checks that the price is the next step of this table. If it is not, the bot stops.
The game allows 10 charges a day. The task ends there.
WholeNumberFromOne: Enter a whole number, 1 or more
WholeNumberFromZero: Enter a whole number, 0 or more
WholeNumberZeroToTen: Enter a whole number from 0 to 10
WebhookUrl_description: Empty = none. When a task stops, the bot sends why to this address.
AutoAcceptTerms_description: Accept the User Agreement on the title screen (off: stop and notify)
AutoDownload_description: Accept game data downloads and updates (off: stop and notify)
KeepDismissedScreens: Save a screenshot before closing a screen
KeepDismissedScreens_description: Save a screenshot before closing a screen (it shows the account: do not share it). The bot saves it only on this computer, in logs/dismissed. It saves these screens: notices, popups, the mailbox, the settings menu, help pages and the Parallel Superposition prompt. It also saves the screen before recovery presses Back.
